description: Build SKU Browser panel component with search/filter UI, grid view with thumbnails, detail view, and assignment action wired into the canvas workflow
steps: Create src/components/SkuBrowser/SkuBrowser.tsx as the main browser panel component. It should be a slide-over or modal panel that opens when isBrowserOpen is true in skuStore. Include a header with title 'SKU Browser' and a close button.

Create src/components/SkuBrowser/SkuFilterBar.tsx with filter controls: ProductType dropdown (WALL_PANEL/LIGHT/FURNITURE), Family dropdown (populated from skuStore.families), Category dropdown (populated from skuStore.categories, filtered by selected family), Material text input, Colour text input, SKU Status toggle (ACTIVE/INACTIVE/All), Catalogue Status toggle (READY/INCOMPLETE/All), and a search input for free-text search by sku_code or material. Include a 'Clear Filters' button.

Create src/components/SkuBrowser/SkuGrid.tsx that displays a grid of SKU cards. Each card shows: thumbnail image (from catalogue RENDER asset file_reference, with fallback placeholder), sku_code, material, colour, dimensions (width x height x thickness mm), and a catalogue status badge (green 'READY' or amber 'INCOMPLETE'). Cards that are not selectable (status != ACTIVE or catalogue != READY) should be visually dimmed.

Create src/components/SkuBrowser/SkuDetailPanel.tsx shown when a SKU is selected (selectedSkuId != null). Display all SKU properties: sku_code, product_type, material, colour, finish, dimensions, pattern_identity, gh_mm/gv_mm, quantity_mode, commercial_attributes, status. Also show catalogue status and compatibility info (if any sku_compatibility records exist for this SKU).

Add an 'Assign to Zone' button in SkuDetailPanel that: validates the SKU is selectable (ACTIVE + catalogue READY), calls projectStore.assignSku(selectedZoneId, selectedSkuId), and closes the browser on success. The button should be disabled if no zone is selected or if the SKU is not selectable.
Create src/components/SkuBrowser/index.ts barrel exporting all components.

Wire the 'Assign SKU' button in ZonePropertiesPanel.tsx to call skuStore.openBrowser() on click. The button should only be visible in DESIGNER mode (already is since ZonePropertiesPanel only renders in designer mode).
Add the SkuBrowser component to App.tsx, rendering it conditionally when skuStore.isBrowserOpen is true. Position it as an overlay/panel on the right side of the canvas.

Create src/components/SkuBrowser/__tests__/SkuBrowser.test.tsx with tests: renders when open, does not render when closed, displays filter bar, displays SKU grid with mock data, selecting a SKU shows detail panel, assign button calls assignSku and closes browser, catalogue status badges render correctly, non-selectable SKUs are dimmed.
Add pagination controls at the bottom of SkuGrid (Previous/Next buttons, page indicator) that call skuStore.setPage().

Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes following the existing pattern (e.g., data-testid='sku-browser-panel', 'sku-filter-product-type', 'sku-card-{skuId}', 'sku-detail-assign-btn', 'sku-browser-close-btn').
acceptance_criteria: SKU Browser panel opens when 'Assign SKU' button is clicked in ZonePropertiesPanel
Filter bar allows filtering by product_type, family, category, material, colour, sku status, catalogue status
SKU grid displays cards with thumbnails, sku_code, dimensions, and status badges
Non-selectable SKUs (not ACTIVE or catalogue not READY) are visually dimmed
Selecting a SKU shows detail panel with all properties
Assign to Zone button calls projectStore.assignSku and closes browser
Assign button is disabled when SKU is not selectable
All new components have data-testid attributes
npm run build passes with no type errors
npx vitest run passes all tests including new component tests
